The service runs a binary located at `/usr/bin/ruvio` with a configuration file in `/etc/ruvio/ruvio.toml`, both standard paths for system services. The comments in the file are informational and do not introduce any risk. All configurations align with expected and secure systemd service practices for a daemon managing local state.
</details>
